allocator.eligibility: Only after inspection and regression tests establish that the deployed private allocator contains the affected integer remainder behavior.
allocator.allowed_runtime_difference: Only the inspected allocator implementation and its version identification; no action-table, launcher, clock, selector, scorer, model, payload or input changes.

shared_stage.backlog_injection: Once, immediately before the first measured candidate batch. Record actual per-probe remaining bytes at the decision instant; never inject hidden replacement backlog each round.
shared_stage.background_semantics: Remaining tails of identified preexisting full requests whose core execution waits for complete upload; received prefixes and payload hashes must be retained and verified.
shared_stage.calibration_request_semantics: All three probes generate real requests in every condition; stage_capture_devices selects forced H_FULL recipients and every other probe takes its real H_NONE fallback. The empty subset retains three generated events.
shared_stage.formal_latency_inputs: Frozen from independent calibration/pilot; no future test completion times or same-model oracle values.
shared_stage.claim_boundary: Diagnostic admission mechanisms, not a rerun of summary-preserving S-CQPG; modeled or empirical latency estimates are not hard physical safety bounds.

ordering.randomized: condition relabeling and design-row order inside each full cycle
ordering.balance_scope: position and directed adjacent transitions within an arm-order block, exact only for complete design cycles
ordering.reset_between_conditions: Drain/verify the previous arm, restart the frozen runtime state, verify fresh timestamps and hashes, and apply only the declared initial state. Retain complete raw records.

phases.calibration: Distinct physical data used for stage characterization. Shared-stage capture only; no controller-comparison result.
phases.pilot: Separate data for instrumentation checks, nuisance variation, feasibility and choosing a fixed formal block count. Freeze decisions before formal outcomes.
phases.formal: Predeclared complete blocks, frozen inputs/controller/calibration/analysis. No stopping, exclusion or retry based on favorable timing, detection, significance or cap outcomes.
